title: S8a: nested project roots discovered by marker (DEC-303 (a18)), so a whole-checkout run does not exit 7 on a nested project
description: DEC-303 (a18) (ODOC-640): the gate attempt on click 7.1.2 failed closed at 3b with glyph exit 7 (examples/complex holds a package 'complex' under a nested project with its own setup.py, which no default root resolves). Ruling: a directory below the repository root holding pyproject.toml, setup.py or setup.cfg is a nested project root; a first-party import in a file inside it resolves first against that nested root's own source roots ("", src, lib relative to the nested root), then against the repository roots; a nested root is consulted only for files beneath it; a directory with no marker stays as today (an import that resolves nowhere keeps the (a7) exit 7); the (a8) never-a-package-root names are unchanged. Rules commit first, tests both ways (a nested marker resolves; the same layout with no marker still exits 7), a docs sentence in ADR 0008 and the README. The gate is then run ONCE from dev with the runner byte-identical to 8db8ee5.
